title: Applied Digital Brings an Additional 75 MW of AI Infrastructure Online at Polaris Forge 1
key_facts: Applied Digital (Nasdaq: APLD) announced on 2 Oct 2026 that the second phase of Building 2 at its Polaris Forge 1 campus in Ellendale, North Dakota, has reached 'Ready for Service'.
This adds 75 MW of critical IT load (the power the computing equipment can draw) across three 25 MW data halls.
It completes Building 2's 150 MW and brings fully operational critical IT load at Polaris Forge 1 to 250 MW.
The campus is described as fully leased and contracted to deliver 400 MW of critical IT load at full buildout.
It follows the first 100 MW building and the initial 75 MW phase of Building 2.
CEO Wes Cummins said securing power is only the starting point and the real work is turning megawatts into usable capacity for customers.
The release does not name the customer or customers.
quote_evidence: The milestone completes Building 2’s full 150 MW of critical IT load and brings fully operational critical IT load at Polaris Forge 1 to 250 MW. The fully leased AI Factory Campus is contracted to deliver 400 MW of critical IT load at full buildout.
Polaris Forge 1 is located in Ellendale, North Dakota, where Applied Digital has operated since 2021
why_it_matters_hint: A large AI data center campus in North Dakota is moving from construction to working capacity, on the company's own account.
notes: Company's own press release: figures are the company's claims with no outside check, no customer is named, and the release carries standard forward-looking-statement warnings.
